entities.summary: Mikhail Yunkov is a former Russian professional ice hockey forward. Yunkov has appeared in over 500 games in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). In the 2004 NHL Entry Draft, Mikhail was drafted 62nd overall in the 2nd round by the Washington Capitals. He is the brother of Alexander Yunkov, who also played ice hockey professionally.
